violated_contract: A failed state probe cannot authorize a mutating recovery. Onboarding caught graph read errors, including canonical unavailability and a replaced account, and treated them like a successfully read empty legacy graph before sending a rebuild POST.
canonical_prevention: Keep the probe and recovery orchestration at the API owner. Propagate probe failures; permit legacy rebuild only after a successful empty non-canonical read, retain canonical conflict as terminal, and exercise request ordering through the production HTTP client against a loopback server.
